text:
## Policy Review & Updates  
**Review Frequency:** Annual (or upon FCA change)
**Last Review:** 2026-01-15
**Next Review:** 2027-01-15  
---
name: Chunk 34/36

raw_entities.name: Policy Review and Updates Framework
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the periodic review and update cycle for banking policies. Establishes an annual review frequency with provisions for ad-hoc reviews triggered by regulatory changes from the FCA. The policy was last reviewed on 2026-01-15 with the next scheduled review on 2027-01-15.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

raw_entities.name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to conduct a comprehensive policy review on an annual basis. This provision establishes the standard cadence for policy evaluation and ensures ongoing compliance with current regulatory standards.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

raw_entities.name: Ad-Hoc Policy Review Upon FCA Regulatory Change
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring immediate or expedited policy review and updates whenever the Financial Conduct Authority issues regulatory changes. This ensures the bank's policies remain aligned with evolving regulatory requirements beyond the standard annual cycle.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority
raw_entities.description: The primary financial services regulator referenced in this policy as the source of regulatory changes that may trigger ad-hoc policy reviews. The FCA's regulatory directives form the basis for policy update triggers.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)
